niece by marriage of Charlotte (Willyams) Rogers

She was probably the Mary Rogers who was co-editor with Charlotte (Willyams) Rogers of Charlotte (Willyams) Pascoe’s Walks about St. Hilary, and therefore possibly CMY\'s correspondent in 1879. [LG]
